claims.text: For one nominal name mentioned by one annotation in file F: 1. a type DECLARED IN F, matched on its full in-file qualname (so Outer.Inner resolves and a bare Inner does not -- searching nested qualnames by leaf name is exactly the fabrication I5 forbids); 2. a type reachable through F's OWN EXPLICIT IMPORT BINDING ... Module-name -> file resolution is done by FILTERING the import edges index.py already computed, never by re-resolving imports here ... 3. nothing. Builtins ... are counted in their own buckets ... A name bound by an import whose module is NOT in this repo is external, not unresolved
claims.why: No resolution implementation in this chunk to verify the ladder steps.
